decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham is very close to our core curing and slicing capabilities and to our stated push into organic lines, so our existing knowledge base gives us good scope to improve and commercialize it further.
Organic Kasseler also builds directly on established smoked pork know-how and certified organic systems, making it a related extension that we can learn from and support efficiently.
Organic pepper salami fits both our salami expertise and our organic expansion strategy, so absorptive capacity is high and the product is worth retaining.

The teriyaki beef in aspic uses some existing aspic knowledge but is a more exotic niche variant with weak visible follow-through, so it likely ties up resources better used in stronger core products.

Fennel-flavoured sliced salami is technologically easy for us to make but sits outside our main traditional and organic priorities, and limited visible market persistence suggests insufficient payoff.
Liver pâté with veal is a premium but highly related extension of our pâté range, where our processing know-how and recipe competence should let us refine and position it effectively.
